info.title: Leap Incentives — Devices
info.description: API for managing program definitions, requirement catalog, field groups, and partner data preferences

get.description: Thin read for idempotency verification and ops. Optional manufacturer/model_number filters narrow to the matching catalog entry. Requires the MANAGE_INCENTIVE_DATA permission.

Free-text search over the device catalog. `q` is split on whitespace; every token must appear (case-insensitive) in the device's searchable text, and results are ranked by trigram similarity. Requires the LOOKUP_INCENTIVES permission. Returns catalog device UUIDs suitable for POST /v1.1/global-connect/incentives/lookups.
Thin read for idempotency verification and ops. Requires the MANAGE_INCENTIVE_DATA permission.

Unauthorized.description: You are not authorized to perform this operation

Forbidden.description: You do not have permission to perform this operation

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found

Conflict.description: Conflict with existing resource (duplicate key or version mismatch)

UnprocessableEntity.description: Valid request but invalid data (e.g., non-APPROVED requirement)

key.description: Unique key identifier for the requirement (e.g., customer.email)

validation_rules.description: Validation rules for the field (e.g., min, max, pattern)

agreement_template_id.description: Template ID for AGREEMENT type requirements

attachment_template_id.description: Template ID for ATTACHMENT type requirements

version.description: Optimistic concurrency version; must match current version

UpdateProgramRequest.description:
Partial update for PUT /programs/{id}. Every field is optional; only the
fields present in the body are changed. No `enabled` default — omitting it
leaves the current value untouched.

program_identifier.description: If present, must match the path segment.

eiaids.description: The program's full set of eligible EIA utility ids (candidate-selection set). Supersedes the single `eiaid` for matching; a customer whose resolved utility eiaid overlaps this set is a candidate.

type.description: Flat field type: STRING, NUMBER, BOOLEAN, DATE, ENUM, PHONE, AGREEMENT, ATTACHMENT, CHECKLIST_CHECK

component_id.description: Unique identifier for the field group component

component_label.description: Human-readable label for the field group

sort_order.description: Display order of the field group

provides.description: List of requirement keys this component provides

requirement_id.description: UUID of the requirement to assign

program_identifier.description: Optional program identifier to scope the preference

field_identifier.description: Identifier of the field this preference applies to

source_id.description: Optional Supabase PK for traceability. Stored, never keyed on.

DeviceUpsertRequest.description: Upsert a device catalog entry by its natural key (manufacturer, model_number), matched case-insensitively. device_category is resolved by name to a category_id; an unknown name is a 422. source_id is stored for traceability but never keyed on.

device_category.description: Device category name (resolved to category_id; 422 if unknown).

source_id.description: Optional Supabase PK for traceability. Stored, never keyed on.

next_offset.description: Offset for the next page, or null when this is the last page.

UtilityUpsertRequest.description: Upsert a utility catalog row keyed by EIA utility id. This is the parent record utility territories reference by eiaid.

UtilityTerritoryUpsertRequest.description: Upsert a utility territory by source_id from incentives-service Supabase. boundary_geometry_ewkb_hex must encode a Polygon or MultiPolygon in SRID 4326; the server normalizes it to MultiPolygon.

source_id.description: Supabase utility_territories.id. Used as the idempotency key.

eiaid.description: Utility EIA ID. Must reference an existing utility row.

boundary_geometry_ewkb_hex.description: EWKB hex geometry payload from PostGIS ST_AsEWKB.

ApprovedDeviceUpsertRequest.description: Upsert an Approved Product List (APL) entry linking a program to a catalogued device. The device is referenced by natural key (manufacturer, model_number) and resolved to device_id; 422 if it is not in the catalog. tier_name, when present, is resolved against this program's tiers; 422 if unknown.

tier_name.description: Optional tier reference resolved to tier_id within this program; 422 if unknown.

CustomerClassification.description:
Customer/site classification used for incentive eligibility and flow routing.
Aligns with the leap-definitions canonical identifier `customer_classification`.
RESIDENTIAL/COMMERCIAL are the historic values; MULTIFAMILY and MANUFACTURED_HOME
are extensions for incentives eligibility (rebate qualification differs across
single-family vs multifamily vs manufactured housing).

BearerAuth.description: Your Leap API key as a Bearer token. Send it in the `Authorization` header: `Authorization: Bearer <api-key>`.
